title: MRI Lumbar Spine without contrast
citation: Meridian Medical Policy MP-RAD-2148 §4.2 (fabricated for demo)

criteria.text: Documented failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative management (physical therapy, NSAIDs or activity modification) within the preceding 6 months.
criteria.need: Progress note or PT discharge summary

criteria.text: Objective radicular findings on physical examination — dermatomal sensory loss, motor weakness or reflex asymmetry.
criteria.need: Physical exam in a signed clinical note

criteria.text: Symptom duration of 6 weeks or more, OR a documented red flag permitting the conservative-care requirement to be waived.
No lumbar MRI performed in the preceding 12 months, unless there is a documented material change in clinical status.
criteria.need: Imaging history from the clinical data repository

title: Infliximab (medical benefit) for rheumatoid arthritis
citation: Northstar Pharmacy Policy NS-PHM-J1745 §3 (fabricated for demo)
docs: TB screening result (IGRA or PPD) within 12 months

criteria.text: Confirmed moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis with objective serologic or inflammatory markers (RF, anti-CCP, CRP or ESR).
Inadequate response to or documented intolerance of methotrexate at 15 mg weekly or greater for at least 3 months.
criteria.need: Medication history and a clinical note describing response

criteria.text: Negative tuberculosis screening (interferon-gamma release assay or PPD) resulted within the preceding 12 months.
Hepatitis B surface antigen screening documented prior to initiation.
Requested dose and interval consistent with FDA labelling for the indication.

title: Lumbar interbody fusion, single level
citation: Cascade Surgical Policy CM-ORT-22633 §2.1 (fabricated for demo)

criteria.text: At least 6 months of structured conservative care, including a supervised physical therapy course, documented contemporaneously.
Imaging demonstrating segmental instability or spondylolisthesis of grade I or higher that correlates with the symptomatic level.
criteria.need: Flexion-extension radiographs or dynamic imaging report

criteria.text: Behavioural health screening completed with no untreated condition expected to affect surgical outcome.
Tobacco cessation for at least 6 weeks prior to the planned procedure, or documented non-smoker status.
